# polaris_semantic_model (Resource)

Manage a Polaris semantic_model. Deletion unregisters without purging object data. Nonempty parent deletion is refused by Polaris.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_semantic_model" "example" {
  catalog       = "warehouse"
  namespace     = ["sales"]
  name          = "chosen"
  document_json = jsonencode({ version = "0.2.0.dev0", semantic_model = jsonencode({ name = "sales", datasets = [] }) })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Containing catalog.
- `document_json` (String) Ossie document object with version and semantic_model (a JSON object serialized as a string).
- `name` (String) Stable object name. Import existing names before applying.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path components; dots remain literal.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metadata_json` (String, Sensitive) Current object metadata, excluding response credential-vending configuration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polaris_semantic_model.example '{"catalog":"warehouse","namespace":["sales"],"name":"chosen"}'
```
